name: cascade_delete
description: In main.go, the DELETE /api/customers/:c_custkey handler explicitly deletes child rows with `DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?` before deleting the parent customer with `DELETE FROM customer WHERE c_custkey = ?`. This matches an application-level delete cascade, and the GET /api/orders endpoint reads from `orders`, so after customer deletion those dependent order rows are permanently gone and that read endpoint returns missing/incomplete data.
